proofs.target: ∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : Polynomial ℝ), p.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 1 → q.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 1 → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval (-1) = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval (-1)) → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval 0 = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval 0) → p = q
proofs.reference_proof:
by
  have qcb_step_jet104_jet_iff : ∀ (p q : Polynomial ℝ) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ), (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval a = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval a) ↔ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ (k + 1) ∣ p - q :=
    by
      intro p q a k
      constructor
      · intro h
        have ht : Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1) ∣ Polynomial.taylor a (p - q) := by
          apply Polynomial.X_pow_dvd_iff.mpr
          intro j hj
          have he : (j.factorial : ℝ) * (Polynomial.taylor a (p - q)).coeff j = 0 := by
            rw [← QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.eval_iterate_derivative]
            simp only [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_sub, Polynomial.eval_sub,
              h j (by omega), sub_self]
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp he).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero j)
        have hm := map_dvd (Polynomial.taylorAlgHom (-a)) ht
        simpa [Polynomial.taylor_taylor, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using hm
      · intro h j hj
        exact QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.jet_eq_of_pow_dvd_sub p q a k j hj h
  have qcb_step_jet104_left : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : Polynomial ℝ), (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval (-1) = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval (-1)) → QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k ∣ p - q :=
    by
      intro k p q h
      exact (qcb_step_jet104_jet_iff p q (-1) k).mp h
  have qcb_step_jet104_right : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : Polynomial ℝ), (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval 0 = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval 0) → QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k ∣ p - q :=
    by
      intro k p q h
      exact (qcb_step_jet104_jet_iff p q 0 k).mp h
  have qcb_step_jet104_coprime : ∀ (k : ℕ), IsCoprime (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k) (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) :=
    by
      intro k
      unfold QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus
        QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus
      apply IsCoprime.pow
      exact Polynomial.isCoprime_X_sub_C_of_isUnit_sub (by norm_num)
  have qcb_step_jet104_product : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : Polynomial ℝ), (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval (-1) = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval (-1)) → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval 0 = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval 0) → (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) ∣ p - q :=
    by
      intro k p q hl hr
      exact (qcb_step_jet104_coprime k).mul_dvd
        (qcb_step_jet104_left k p q hl) (qcb_step_jet104_right k p q hr)
  have qcb_step_jet104_degree : ∀ (k : ℕ), ((QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k)).natDegree = 2 * k + 2 :=
    by
      intro k
      unfold QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus
        QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _))
        (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _))]
      simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
      omega
  have qcb_step_jet104_annihilate : ∀ (k : ℕ) (d : Polynomial ℝ), d.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 1 → (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) ∣ d → d = 0 :=
    by
      intro k d hb hdiv
      by_contra hne
      have hd := Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdiv hne
      rw [qcb_step_jet104_degree k] at hd
      omega
  intro k p q hp hq hl hr
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  exact qcb_step_jet104_annihilate k (p - q)
    ((Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le p q).trans (max_le hp hq))
    (qcb_step_jet104_product k p q hl hr)

by
  have qcb_step_jet104_jet_iff : ∀ (p q : Polynomial ℝ) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ), (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval a = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval a) ↔ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ (k + 1) ∣ p - q :=

      · intro h j hj

  have qcb_step_jet104_degree : ∀ (k : ℕ), ((QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k)).natDegree = 2 * k + 2 :=
    by
      intro k
      unfold QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus
        QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _))
        (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _))]
      simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
      omega
  have qcb_step_hboundary_degree : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k)).natDegree = 2 * k + 2 :=
    by
      intro k c hc
      rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul hc, qcb_step_jet104_degree k]
  have qcb_step_hboundary_nonzero : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) ≠ 0 :=
    by
      intro k c hc
      apply mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr hc)
      exact mul_ne_zero
        (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (-1 : ℝ)))
        (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (0 : ℝ)))
  have qcb_step_hboundary_left_jet : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ k → (Polynomial.derivative^[j] (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k))).eval (-1) = 0 :=
    by
      intro k c j hj
      have hdiv : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((-1) : ℝ)) ^ (k + 1) ∣
          Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) - 0 := by
        refine ⟨Polynomial.C c * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k, ?_⟩
        dsimp [QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus]
        ring
      have he := (qcb_step_jet104_jet_iff
        (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k)) 0 ((-1)) k).mpr hdiv j hj
      simpa only [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero] using he
  have qcb_step_hboundary_right_jet : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ k → (Polynomial.derivative^[j] (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k))).eval 0 = 0 :=
    by
      intro k c j hj
      have hdiv : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (0 : ℝ)) ^ (k + 1) ∣
          Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) - 0 := by
        refine ⟨Polynomial.C c * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k, ?_⟩
        dsimp [QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus]
        ring
      have he := (qcb_step_jet104_jet_iff
        (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k)) 0 (0) k).mpr hdiv j hj
      simpa only [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero] using he
  have qcb_step_hboundary_family : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k) ≠ 0 ∧ (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k)).natDegree = 2 * k + 2 ∧ (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k))).eval (-1) = 0) ∧ (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] (Polynomial.C c * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus k * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus k))).eval 0 = 0)) :=
    by
      intro k c hc
      exact ⟨qcb_step_hboundary_nonzero k c hc,
        qcb_step_hboundary_degree k c hc,
        qcb_step_hboundary_left_jet k c,
        qcb_step_hboundary_right_jet k c⟩
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hne, hdegree, hleft, hright⟩ := qcb_step_hboundary_family 0 1 (by norm_num)
  have he := h 0
    (Polynomial.C (1 : ℝ) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.leftModulus 0 * QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.rightModulus 0))
    (0 : Polynomial ℝ)
    (by omega)
    (by simp)
    (fun j hj => by simpa only [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero] using hleft j hj)
    (fun j hj => by simpa only [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero] using hright j hj)
  exact hne he
